item.description:
Production Desk 1.5.2

  • Draw coverage, arrows, and notes across page boundaries with Continuous scroll in Lined script. Edge scrolling keeps long strokes moving; original PDFs and page exports retain their layout.
  • Create a scrollable copy from imported Final Draft, Fountain, or text script scenes when an original PDF is unavailable.
  • Right-click shots and coverage lines to delete them. Linked deletion removes both the shot and its linked coverage, with separate Don't show again choices and Undo. Restore warnings from Settings.
  • Find New production as a plus above the production picker and Production settings at the bottom of the sidebar.
  • Find bug and crash reporting in Settings. The local-save notice now appears beneath the software credit.
  • Keep short coverage strokes usable in long scripts and release offscreen page images while scrolling.

Existing productions and original PDFs are preserved. Full backups retain editable annotations and attached PDFs.
